title: Free Christian Baptist Church 1900s and parsonage, Hartland Superior School to the right
description: Parsonage of the Free Baptist Church, next to the Free (Christian) Baptist Church and the Hartland Superior School on lower Main Street. The parsonage was vacated and rented to Estey and Curtis for their pharmacist, George Dunham. It was later sold to Harold Aiton, then Adrian Hovey and Sterling Hallett. This was built in the late 1800s for the Free Baptist Church and remains in use today. (2026)
